name: kattakath-nix-config
description: In-repo Claude Code plugins for this fleet. Pinned by Nix source path (modules/shared/home.nix), never fetched from a third-party marketplace.

plugins.name: llmstxt
plugins.description: Author spec-compliant llms.txt (and the de-facto llms-full.txt) from any body of written work — docs, a site, a repo, or a developer accomplishment document.

plugins.name: userscript-author
plugins.description: Author and maintain Violentmonkey/Tampermonkey userscripts for Chromium to a greasyfork.org-publishable standard — a measure-before-you-select method, pre-vetted code patterns, browser probes, and a runnable Greasy Fork metadata linter.

plugins.name: seargraph
plugins.description: Agent-development helper for SEARGraph — self-evolving agentic image restoration on LangGraph (fidelity metrics, constrained optimization, iterative refinement, character embeddings).
